text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A large group of students is training
together, but
my eyes gradually fall on
the lone figure watching
them from afar.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um, we're gonna do a group training
session with
everyone who's still
around...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If you're interested, would you like to
join us?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Nope. Find someone else for your
games.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian turns down their offer so
harshly, I
can't help but wonder if there's
a reason she
doesn't want to run with
them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day on my way home after school, I
see her
running on the track.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then leave me alone. You're distracting
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then leave me alone. You're distracting
me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No, duh. I always make sure to keep my
training
balanced.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Was that all you came here to say? Can I
get
back to training already?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian dismisses me curtly and
continues
running again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... So you saw, huh? Yeah, I focus
better when
I'm alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian runs off without a second
glance at
me.
